brief:
The UK announced sanctions on illegal Israeli settlements in the West Bank, a move that prompted divided reactions within the British Jewish community. Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband unveiled the trade restrictions targeting settlements deemed illegal under international law, The Guardian reported through readers' letters responding to the policy.

Some Jewish communal leaders and organizations expressed disappointment at the sanctions, while others, including a religious Jew quoted in the letters section, said the measure represented an appropriate step. The announcement sparked debate within Jewish communities over how to address settlement expansion and the legitimacy of trade restrictions as a policy response.
dek: Readers respond to the move announced by Ed Miliband to impose sanctions on illegal Israeli settlements As a religious Jew, I am disappointed at the reaction of some of our communal leaders and bodies to the sanctions on trade with illegal Israeli settlements…
title: UK sanctions on West Bank settlers draw mixed Jewish response
